CustomField.description: This field used for Customer Portal Cases to indicate a web icon and flag when a case comment added and File upload on case.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Origin, "Web"),NOT ( Read_All_Customer_Comments__c ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "New")) , IMAGE("/resource/web_icon", "New Web", 20, 20 ) , IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Origin, "Web"),NOT ( Read_All_Customer_Comments__c ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Escalated")) , IMAGE("/resource/web_icon", "New Web", 20, 20) , IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Origin, "Web"),NOT ( Read_All_Customer_Comments__c ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress")) , IMAGE("/resource/web_icon", "New Web", 20, 20) , IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Origin, "Web"),NOT ( Read_All_Customer_Comments__c )) , Image("/img/samples/flag_red.gif","Email Received") , "" ))))
CustomField.label: Comment Indicator
